coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing chi (read approximately from log-scale plots)
notes: Laboratory-based (non-DM) bounds on hidden-photon kinetic mixing chi from AFM Casimir measurements (mass range ~0.1-10 eV, chi >~ 10^-0.5, red curve Fig.1/Fig.6) and the Plimpton-Lawton Coulomb's law test (sensitivity gamma=3.3e-10, purple curve Fig.7 spanning ~10^-13 to ~10^-2 eV). Exact numerical exclusion values are not tabulated; data_points are rough estimates read from the log-scale exclusion plots and should be treated as approximate. Two distinct experimental setups are combined here; downstream users may wish to separate them.
